name: Speech Cadence Analysis
description: Analyzes speech rhythm, pacing, and prosody patterns to detect AI-generated voice in videos.
useCase: Detecting synthetic speech in deepfake videos through temporal speech pattern analysis
mechanism: Extracts speech rate, pause duration, pitch contour, and emphasis patterns from audio tracks. Natural speech has characteristic variability in cadence, while AI-generated speech often shows unnatural uniformity or periodic patterns in rhythm and intonation.
source: Müller et al. (2022) - Does Audio Deepfake Detection Generalize?, Interspeech
algorithm: Prosody Feature Extraction + Temporal Pattern Analysis + Statistical Deviation Scoring
parameters: Window: 500ms, Features: F0 contour, speech rate, pause ratio, jitter, shimmer
strengths:
• Effective against text-to-speech deepfakes
• Complements visual analysis methods
• Language-independent prosody features
• Robust to visual compression artifacts
limitations:
• Requires clear audio track
• Less effective on short clips
• Background noise reduces accuracy
• May not detect high-quality neural TTS

references.title: Müller, N. et al. (2022). Does Audio Deepfake Detection Generalize? Interspeech.
Yi, J. et al. (2022). ADD 2022: The First Audio Deep Synthesis Detection Challenge. ICASSP.
Blue, L. et al. (2022). Who Are You (I Really Wanna Know)? Detecting Audio DeepFakes Through Vocal Tract Reconstruction. USENIX.
